title: Quick Romantic Italian Chicken Liver Bigoli
description: A herbal and snappy Tuscan dish featuring chicken liver and confit tomato, perfect for a romantic evening, this pescatarian friendly bigoli recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bigoli pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the sliced chicken liver, cooking until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken liver from the skillet and set aside, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the confit tomato to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring to scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Drain the cooked bigoli pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the tomato and parsley mixture.
Return the cooked chicken liver to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve hot topped with grated parmesan cheese.
